ne.name: Northeastern Zone
ne.bounds: East and north of I-5 (Oregon line to Weed, via Walters Lane, Easy Street and Old Highway 99 near Yreka), Highway 89, the Greenville / Indian Valley roads, Highway 70 and Highway 395 to the Nevada line.
ne.note: Ducks Oct 3 – Jan 13. Canada geese Oct 3 – Jan 10; white and white-fronted Oct 3 – Nov 29 and Jan 1–13, late Feb 5 – Mar 10. Klamath Basin SMA: white and white-fronted to Jan 15.

bos.name: Balance of State Zone
bos.bounds: The rest of California outside the Northeastern, Southern San Joaquin Valley, Southern and Colorado River zones.
bos.note: Ducks Oct 24 – Jan 31. Geese Oct 24 – Jan 31 (large Canada early Oct 3–5; late Feb 20–21 Canada, Feb 20–24 white and white-fronted). North Coast SMA (Del Norte, Humboldt): Canada geese Oct 3 – Dec 19 and Feb 12 – Mar 10.

ssjv.name: Southern San Joaquin Valley Zone
ssjv.bounds: All of Kings and Tulare counties and Kern County north of the Southern Zone.

so.name: Southern California Zone
so.bounds: South and east of the Santa Maria River, Highways 101/166, 166 and 99, I-5 to Tejon Pass, the Tehachapi crest to Walker Pass, Highways 178, 395, 58, I-15 and 127 to the Nevada line (excluding the Colorado River Zone).
so.note: Ducks and geese Oct 24 – Jan 31. Imperial County SMA white geese to Feb 21 (set dates).

cr.name: Colorado River Zone
cr.bounds: San Bernardino, Riverside and Imperial counties east of Highway 95, the Rice / Aqueduct Road, Highway 62, Desert Center–Rice Road, I-10, Wiley Well and Milpitas Wash roads, Blythe–Ogilby Road, Ogilby Road, I-8 and Highway 186 to Mexico.

seasonsNote: Five zones. Special management areas (North Coast, Klamath Basin, Sacramento Valley, Imperial County, Humboldt Bay South Spit, Morro Bay, Martis Creek Lake) change goose dates or limits inside them — see the notes.

seasons.label: Canada and other dark geese
seasons.note: Large Canada geese closed in the late seasons. North Coast SMA (Del Norte, Humboldt): all Canada geese Oct 3 – Dec 19 and Feb 12 – Mar 10, 10 a day (1 large). Klamath Basin SMA: Canada geese Oct 3 – Jan 10.

seasons.label: White and white-fronted geese
seasons.note: Klamath Basin SMA: Oct 3 – Jan 15. Sacramento Valley SMA: white-fronted geese only through Dec 21 (3 a day). Imperial County SMA white geese: Nov 4 – Jan 31, Feb 1–5, 8–12 and 16–21 (20 a day).

seasons.label: Black brant
seasons.note: Northern Brant Area (Del Norte and Humboldt) Nov 29 – Dec 14; Balance of State Brant Area Nov 30 – Dec 15. Humboldt Bay South Spit (west side) closed to all hunting during brant season; Morro Bay open in designated areas from the brant opener.

seasons.label: Veterans / active military days
seasons.note: Ducks only in the Northeastern and Balance of State zones.

bags.detail: Seven ducks, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily bag.
Dark geese: Northeastern 10 (≤6 white-fronted, ≤3 large Canada); Balance of State and S. San Joaquin 10 (≤6 white-fronted; Sacramento Valley SMA ≤3 white-fronted); Southern 3; Colorado River 4.
White geese 20 in every zone (total goose bag 30, or 23 Southern, 24 Colorado River).

duckSublimits.note: no more than 2 females (or Mexican ducks in the Colorado River Zone)

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset (CDFW tables).
Nonlead shot is required for all hunting in California; shotguns limited to 3 shells for waterfowl.

Most Type A and B areas run by reservation drawing and set hunt days; check CDFW before you go. Not drawn: Humboldt Bay South Spit (west side, closed during brant season), Morro Bay (designated areas), Martis Creek Lake (closed until Nov 16).
North Coast (Del Norte, Humboldt), Klamath Basin, Sacramento Valley and Imperial County SMAs change goose dates and limits — see the goose notes. Their road-described outlines are not drawn.
Youth: Sept 19–20 Northeastern; Feb 13–14 elsewhere. Veterans / military: Jan 16–17 Northeastern (ducks only); Feb 6–7 Balance of State (ducks only), S. San Joaquin and Southern.

licences.t: Type A / B season pass or entry permit

geometryNote: Geometry: zone lines routed on the roads and the Santa Maria River named in the zone wording (OpenStreetMap), Census TIGER county lines for the Southern San Joaquin Valley Zone, and an approximation of the Tehachapi crest; split against the Census TIGER outline; CDFW public access lands; OSM boat ramps; USGS NHD and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); NOAA tides.
